content.text: No audit right against PB exists anywhere in the document. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 9.1 Accounting. Each Party will maintain materially complete and accurate accounting records related to this Agreement in accordance with GAAP.
input.rationale: The Agreement grants SFJ no audit, inspection or verification right over PB, its records, premises or systems. Article 9 (p0624–p0625) imposes only mutual record-keeping/retention obligations (GAAP accounting records; Development books and records "in sufficient detail to verify compliance"), with no accompanying access or examination right. § 3.6 (p0321–p0322) is a mutual quality-oversight regime in which each Party audits its own Permitted Third Parties (and PB audits the Product manufacturing facilities) and shares the resulting reports — SFJ audits PB's vendors' facilities, not PB. § 3.5.5 (p0318) and § 5.4.4.3 (p0453) are report-sharing and regulatory-inspection notification provisions, and § 3.18.2 (p0367) is financial-statement reporting; none confers audit or system-access rights. There is therefore no frequency, notice, cost or system-access term to constrain: the position is better than preferred (zero audit exposure for us), so no redline is warranted. We note for the record that the "sufficient detail to verify compliance" language in § 9.2 should not later be argued into an implied access right; if SFJ seeks an express audit right in negotiation, we would apply the preferred limits (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, SFJ's cost, no system access).
